_comment: Octail's own egg (pelican-eggs' games-standalone openarena egg was only read for reference: it downloads over plain HTTP with nothing checked and no failure handling). Octail downloads the official 0.8.8 release zip (TuxFamily, SourceForge as the mirror), checks it against the MD5 OpenArena publishes and a SHA-256 recorded in the script, unpacks only the Linux 64-bit dedicated server, baseoa/ and missionpack/ (a reinstall keeps server.cfg and added files), writes a minimal baseoa/server.cfg once and edits it with the file parser before every start (name, slots, message of the day, join password, rcon password, game type, bots), starts the first map and the public listing from the command line, runs on octail-yolks' Debian image and adds the say broadcast, the UDP port start check, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: OpenArena
author: eggs@octail.net
description: OpenArena is a free, open-source arena shooter on the ioquake3 engine: deathmatch, tournament, capture the flag, elimination, domination and more, with bots.
startup: [ -x ./oa_ded.x86_64 ] || { echo "OpenArena is not installed: reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; exec ./oa_ded.x86_64 +set fs_basepath "$(pwd)" +set fs_homepath "$(pwd)" +set dedicated $((1 + {{PUBLIC_LIST}})) +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set com_hunkmegs 128 +exec server.cfg +map "{{MAP}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenArena installation script (Octail): the official 0.8.8 release zip (TuxFamily, SourceForge as the mirror),
# checked against the MD5 OpenArena publishes next to it and the SHA-256 recorded here, with only what the
# dedicated server needs unpacked: the Linux 64-bit dedicated server, baseoa/ and missionpack/. Failures exit
# non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

## OpenArena 0.8.8, the current release (2012). The MD5 is the one in
## https://download.tuxfamily.org/openarena/rel/088/openarena-0.8.8.md5sum.txt; there is no published SHA-256, so
## Octail recorded the zip's own (2026-10-13). A new release needs both updated here.
VERSION=0.8.8
ZIP=openarena-0.8.8.zip
MD5=9f353d96d7889c377349d692c3905e5b
SHA256=5a8faf7f5b51f351b0a1618c06b6b98a5f1a6758f1d39818de2c87df2a0bac4a

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip ca-certificates > /dev/null

if [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: this egg installs OpenArena's Linux x86_64 server (this node is $(uname -m))."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
## about 420 MB: downloaded into the server folder (the installer's /tmp may be small), removed afterwards
DL=/mnt/server/.openarena-download.zip
OK=
for URL in "https://download.tuxfamily.org/openarena/rel/088/${ZIP}" "https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/oarena/${ZIP}"; do
    echo "Downloading ${URL}"
    if curl -fSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 1800 --retry 3 -o "$DL" "$URL" &&
        echo "${MD5}  ${DL}" | md5sum -c --quiet - && echo "${SHA256}  ${DL}" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
        OK=1
        break
    fi
    echo "That download failed or doesn't match its checksums; trying the next mirror."
done
if [ -z "$OK" ]; then
    rm -f "$DL"
    echo "Installation failed: no mirror gave a download matching OpenArena ${VERSION}'s checksums."
    exit 1
fi

## the release's own files only: server.cfg, maps and anything else you added to baseoa/ stay
rm -rf /mnt/server/.openarena-unpack
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.openarena-unpack baseoa missionpack
unzip -q -o "$DL" 'openarena-0.8.8/oa_ded.x86_64' 'openarena-0.8.8/baseoa/*' 'openarena-0.8.8/missionpack/*' \
    -d /mnt/server/.openarena-unpack
rm -f "$DL"
U=/mnt/server/.openarena-unpack/openarena-0.8.8
if [ ! -f "$U/oa_ded.x86_64" ] || [ ! -f "$U/baseoa/pak0.pk3" ]; then
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.openarena-unpack
    echo "Installation failed: the dedicated server or its data is missing from ${ZIP}."
    exit 1
fi
mv -f "$U"/baseoa/* baseoa/
mv -f "$U"/missionpack/* missionpack/
mv -f "$U/oa_ded.x86_64" .
chmod +x oa_ded.x86_64
rm -rf /mnt/server/.openarena-unpack

## a minimal baseoa/server.cfg, only when there is none; Octail sets the lines below before every start
if [ ! -f baseoa/server.cfg ]; then
    cat > baseoa/server.cfg <<'EOF'
// OpenArena server settings. Octail sets the lines below before every start (Startup tab); add your own
// settings under them (fraglimit, timelimit, capturelimit, g_motd, map rotation with vstr, ...).
set sv_hostname "OpenArena Server"
set sv_maxclients 12
set g_motd ""
set g_password ""
set rconpassword ""
set g_gametype 0
set bot_minplayers 0
set fraglimit 20
set timelimit 15
EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: OpenArena ${VERSION}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (up to 64 characters, no double quotes or backslashes; ^1-^7 colour codes work).

variables.name: Public Server List
variables.description: 1 lists the server on the OpenArena master server; 0 keeps it off the list (players join by address).

variables.name: Start Map
variables.description: The map loaded at start, such as oa_dm1, aggressor, oa_bases3 (capture the flag) or a map you upload into baseoa/ as a .pk3.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: 0 free for all, 1 tournament, 3 team deathmatch, 4 capture the flag, 5 one flag CTF, 6 overload, 7 harvester, 8 elimination, 9 CTF elimination, 10 last man standing, 11 double domination, 12 domination. Team modes need a map made for them.

variables.name: Bots
variables.description: Bots fill the server up to this many players (0 = no bots); they leave as people join.

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: Optional: shown while players connect (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = anyone can join. No double quotes or backslashes.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional: the remote console password for the in-game /rcon commands (8-64 characters, no spaces, quotes, backslashes, semicolons or carets). Hidden once saved. Empty = rcon off.
